name: Activity
description: Lead activity history (js/activity.js): one record per event on a CRM lead (created, status, customer details, notes, assigned employee, estimates, signatures, invoices, payments). Append-only: the app only creates records, never changes them. legacy_id = app id (act-xxxx, or act-sig-<signature>-signed / act-pay-<payment> for events several devices can notice).

kind.description: created, deleted, customer, status, notes, assigned, schedule, estimate, email, signature_sent, signed, signature_withdrawn, invoice, payment, paid, task, followup, other

actor.description: Who did it: the employee's name or email, or 'Client: <name>' for a signature
